text:
Alex: Hey sec team — about to merge PR that narrows service account scopes for onprem sidecar. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/812
Sam: quick summary: we removed broad k8s cluster-admin binding, added per-namespace SA + RBAC minimal role, and switched KMS path from global to tenant-scoped.
Maria: thanks. does this change any VPC egress or cross-tenant key access?
Alex: VPC egress unchanged. KMS path change means the sidecar will call customer-keystore (tenant-XYZ) instead of /global. No shared keys.
Jordan: code looks small. main ask: can we rotate keys without restart? any replay or caching risk?
Alex: yes rotation handled via watcher; uses cached token with 5m TTL. we added a test in e2e. here's the diff snippet:
```
ENV KMS_PATH=/tenants/${TENANT_ID}/keys/sidecar
watcher.loop(interval=300)
```
Ethan: quick security checklist: secrets not in logs, KMS calls with established service identity, SA only has get/list for secrets, no write. I can run a quick smoke.
Alex: planning to merge in today's 16:00 PT deploy window if sec OK. pinging @Maria @Ethan for LGTM. @Sam can you hold the merge if anything blocks?
Sam: yep will hold.
Maria: I can do a full review in 30m. can you add an explicit acceptance test for token rotation timing?
Alex: will add now; it's small. also added comment about audit logs for KMS calls.
SecBot: Note: risk=low, requires audit_policy=yes on tenant-keystore; please confirm retention settings.
Ethan: I ran smoke — no creds leaking in logs, SA permissions look tight. would like one more quick run on staging with tenant 456.
Alex: running staging now, ping when done.
(10m later)
Alex: staging pass, audit logs show KMS read events, no 403s. added acceptance test. ready to merge pending Maria LGTM.
Maria: LGTM. only nit: clarify env var name to TENANT_KEY_PATH. otherwise good. :thumbsup:
Alex: done. merging after deploy window signoff. thanks all.
